comment: The "Foundational capability" table title implies comprehensive coverage of REDDHI's foundation, but every row and component listed is technical infrastructure. The ongoing REDDHI readiness index by HQ/MIS treats financing/sustainability and data analytics (including workforce and institutional capacity) as equally foundational, with neither represented in this table.

public.text: The "Foundational capability" table title implies comprehensive coverage of REDDHI's foundation, but every row and component listed is technical infrastructure. The ongoing REDDHI readiness index by HQ/MIS treats financing/sustainability and data analytics (including workforce and institutional capacity) as equally foundational, with neither represented in this table.
public.suggestedRevision: Not sure, maybe retitle the table to specify its technical scope, and add a cross-reference noting that financing and institutional/workforce readiness are addressed separately (e.g. via the readiness index. Or align with HQ/MIS on REDDHI Readiness Index.
